meta: Write your LinkedIn profile with AI: a profile with only a job title and a school name is almost invisible to recruiters.

muc.title: An invisible profile
muc.text: A LinkedIn profile with only a job title and a school name is almost invisible to recruiters searching for people.

muc.title: One line that says who you are
muc.text: Ask AI for five headline versions, each saying clearly what you can do and for whom.

muc.title: Three tasks, three results
muc.text: In the About section, list three things you've done with their results, then ask AI to turn them into a short paragraph.

muc.title: A cover letter
muc.text: A letter to a recruiter should be short, name the company correctly, and give one concrete reason you fit the role.

muc.title: Rewrite your About
muc.text: Paste your current About section into a chatbot, ask for three shorter rewrites, then pick one.
